issue.title: Schema card field jumps, numbered fields, and grouped rhythm
issue.description: On the album Schema Card (opened from album and record notes), Shift+J/Shift+K step between fields and 1–9 jump straight to a numbered field, with a keycap showing each field's number beside its name and clear space between field groups. On the bank Setup card (~/bob/bank.md), Shift+J/Shift+K step between category groups while digit hotkeys keep working. Every jump is pure navigation that never writes, and the numbers and jumps always follow the order painted on screen.
